instructions: Training (LMS) FAQ only. Use for short Q&A; use the paired Word document for detailed how-tos and edge cases. Follow the common rule book for shared assistant behaviour across all modules.

faqs.question: What is Training / LMS?
faqs.answer: Training is the TEF LMS e-learning experience for the TEF Entrepreneurship Programme: sequenced courses with agreement, assessments, lessons, quizzes, feedback, and progress tracking. Branding uses TEFCONNECT.

faqs.question: How do I open Training from TEFConnect?
faqs.answer: Side menu Training/LMS when LMS status is active opens the external training site (often a new tab) via a secure link. You may also use LMS login or SSO.

faqs.question: Who can use learner Training?
faqs.answer: Entrepreneur and partner learner accounts. Staff use admin Training. Mentors are not a standard learner Training role.

faqs.question: What happens first time I enter Training?
faqs.answer: If training has not started: Welcome to the TEF 2026 Entrepreneurship Programme → Start Training → accept Training Participation Agreement if required → E-Learning Dashboard / My Courses.

faqs.question: What is Programmes Training vs General Training?
faqs.answer: Programmes Training shows My Program Courses when you have programme courses. General Training shows General Courses and is always available. Use Find a course / Search.

faqs.question: Why is a course locked?
faqs.answer: Programme courses unlock in order — complete the previous course first. A course may also be Not Available before start or Expired after access ends.

faqs.question: What is the learning order inside a course?
faqs.answer: Pre-Assessment when required → modules/lessons in sequence → Module Feedback & Rating → Post-Assessment when curriculum complete.

faqs.question: How do Pre/Post-Assessment work?
faqs.answer: Configured per course; attempted only once; timed; do not refresh/close; tab-switch warnings may appear; pass/fail from training system; score may be hidden.

faqs.question: How do module quizzes work?
faqs.answer: Timed quiz lessons; if already attempted you cannot retake and should continue; Submit Quiz before time ends; messaging may reference ~70% performance but progress follows completion flags.

faqs.question: What can I do in a lesson?
faqs.answer: View video/document content, attachments, Mark as Complete, Set Reminder. Languages: English, French, Portuguese, Arabic.

faqs.question: What is Module Feedback & Rating?
faqs.answer: After module lessons, rate 1–5 stars with optional feedback. May be locked until other module lessons are complete.

faqs.question: How do I update my Training profile?
faqs.answer: My Profile from learner menu: name, email, phone, country, city, about, preferred language, profile image (JPEG/JPG/PNG under 2 MB).

faqs.question: How do I return to TEFConnect from Training?
faqs.answer: Application Home or Sign Out from the learner header (configured destinations).

faqs.question: What if Training fails in TEFConnect?
faqs.answer: Dashboard may show Did not Complete Training. Mentorship is disabled when LMS status is FAILED.

faqs.question: Can I download a Training certificate?
faqs.answer: Certificate preview/download is not a working learner action yet; certificate route returns to course details.

faqs.question: What is not available for learners?
faqs.answer: LMS Marketplace Coming Soon; separate My Courses page Coming Soon; certificate download not working; no admin Course Management for learners.

faqs.question: Is there a training deadline?
faqs.answer: Programme courses may show a deadline before the training end date to continue the entrepreneurship journey with Tony Elumelu Foundation.

faqs.question: Is there a discussion forum?
faqs.answer: Yes. Learners can create topics and reply in course discussion. Admins also manage forums.

faqs.question: What buttons appear on courses?
faqs.answer: Start Learning, Continue Learning, Expired, Not Available.

faqs.question: How many courses per page?
faqs.answer: 9 courses per page on the learner grid.

faqs.question: Default assessment length?
faqs.answer: Course setup defaults often use 20 questions and 30 minutes unless the course defines otherwise. A 20-minute fallback timer may apply if duration is missing; 5-minute warning can appear.

faqs.question: Can I retake pre-assessment?
faqs.answer: Instructions say attempted only once; start is disabled if already attempted.

faqs.question: Quiz already attempted.
faqs.answer: You cannot retake; proceed to the next lesson.

faqs.question: No pre-assessment configured.
faqs.answer: You may go directly to lessons.

faqs.question: No post-assessment configured.
faqs.answer: A dedicated empty state is shown.

faqs.question: Please complete the previous course to unlock this course.
faqs.answer: Finish the previous programme course in order, then the next unlocks.

faqs.question: Training missing from TEFConnect menu.
faqs.answer: Training shows when a programme has active LMS status (not pending/not started).

faqs.question: What is E-Learning Dashboard?
faqs.answer: The learner home for My Courses / training dashboard after agreement.

faqs.question: Set Reminder.
faqs.answer: From lesson/quiz/pre-assessment pages, set a reminder message and date/time.

faqs.question: Status filters on My Courses?
faqs.answer: All, In Progress, Not Started, Completed.

faqs.question: Do not refresh during assessment.
faqs.answer: Assessment instructions warn not to refresh/close; browser back is disabled on the quiz; timer can auto-submit.

faqs.question: Training PASSED — Mentorship still disabled?
faqs.answer: Mentorship disables on LMS FAILED. If PASSED and Mentorship missing, check application_approved and Mentorship rules.

faqs.question: Can learners publish courses?
faqs.answer: No. Course Management is admin-only.

faqs.question: Application Home goes where?
faqs.answer: Toward TEFConnect application home from the learner header.

faqs.question: Profile photo too large.
faqs.answer: Use JPEG/JPG/PNG under 2 MB.

faqs.question: General Training always available?
faqs.answer: Yes. General Courses are always available; Program tab needs programme courses.

faqs.question: Course reviews.
faqs.answer: Course details may offer reviews and ratings where available.

faqs.question: Post-assessment locked.
faqs.answer: Complete the curriculum’s required lessons first.

faqs.question: Failed post-assessment.
faqs.answer: You may be returned to post-assessment result; certificate-oriented checks can be blocked.

faqs.question: Unlock your Entrepreneurial Potentials.
faqs.answer: Learner hero positioning copy for Training.

faqs.question: Is Marketplace inside LMS real?
faqs.answer: Marketplace in LMS is a Coming Soon placeholder, not the TEFConnect Marketplace module.

faqs.question: SSO into LMS.
faqs.answer: You can arrive via SSO callback token as well as email/password login on LMS.

faqs.question: Course progress percentage.
faqs.answer: Shown from learner progress for each course.

faqs.question: Video types.
faqs.answer: Native video or YouTube/Vimeo embeds may be used.

faqs.question: What do admins do in Training?
faqs.answer: Entrepreneurs List, Course Management, Discussion Forum, Agreement Management, Reports. Learners should not expect these tools.

faqs.question: My Courses page Coming Soon.
faqs.answer: Header My Courses opens the e-learning dashboard; a separate My Courses page is Coming Soon.

faqs.question: Training Participation Agreement title.
faqs.answer: TEF 2026 Entrepreneurship Programme Participation Agreement.

faqs.question: Blocked/expired contact administrator.
faqs.answer: If access is blocked/expired, follow the message and contact an administrator when instructed.
